# Project Overview

**LegacyLoom** is a project created during the **AI Vibe Coding Hackathon** (March 6-8, 2026). It aims to capture and preserve family memories by transforming them into engaging stories and videos that can be kept and shared across generations.

### 🔗 [Live Demo](https://legacyloom-nine.vercel.app/){target="_blank"}

## The Mission

"Their stories won't wait" — LegacyLoom was built with the urgent mission of preserving the voices, memories, and wisdom of our ancestors before they are lost. Using AI-driven storytelling, we bridge the gap between oral tradition and digital preservation.

## Hackathon Achievement

This project was built in just 72 hours during the AI Vibe Coding Hackathon. It focuses on:  
- **Emotion-first engineering**: Creating an interface that respects the sensitivity of old memories.  
- **AI-Generated Narratives**: Using LLMs to weave raw details into coherent, moving stories.  
- **Cinematic Experience**: Generating visuals and voices to bring the past to life.
